name: Density-Sensitive Transformer
title: Global and Uniform Point Cloud Completion With Density-Sensitive Transformer for Small-Scale 3-D Object Reconstruction
summary: 面向小型工业零件残缺点云，通过位置与特征编码、粗点云密度重建和密度敏感 Transformer，同时恢复结构完整性与密度均匀性。

name: SA-LPCC
title: A Task-Driven Scene-Aware LiDAR Point Cloud Coding Framework for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: 根据自动驾驶建图与定位需求，区分可移动目标、地面和其余点，结合语义筛选、地面拟合与帧间预测进行 LiDAR 点云编码。

name: LIOR De-Dust
title: Design of a LIOR-Based De-Dust Filter for LiDAR Sensors in Off-Road Vehicles
summary: 将低强度候选筛选与半径邻域复核结合，用于越野车辆扬尘环境的 LiDAR 点云去尘。

name: SCFNR
title: A Real-Time SCFNR-Based Point Cloud Denoising Method for Autonomous Driving in Adverse Mining Environments
summary: 在矿区雾、尘、雪干扰下，结合球形度特征、多尺度分类与地面邻域上下文，进行实时点云噪声过滤。

name: DHE-Net
title: Dual-Encoder Hierarchical Network for Real-World Low-Cost LiDAR Point Cloud Denoising
summary: 真实 noisy–clean 配对数据集 RealLiD，以及结合空间顺序与双异构编码器的点云去噪方法。

name: DSOR
title: A Scalable Statistical Filter for Removing Falling Snow from LiDAR Point Clouds in Severe Winter Weather
summary: 以随距离调整的统计阈值过滤落雪杂波，同时提出严重冬季天气逐点标注数据集 WADS。

name: Electric Arc Noise
title: Multi-Structure Mapping for Filtering Electric Arc Noise in Power Line Environments
summary: 利用连续扫描的局部邻域与全局占据地图，过滤输电线路巡检中的电弧伪回波。

name: CNNWeatherNet
title: CNN-Based Lidar Point Cloud De-Noising in Adverse Weather
summary: 在二维 LiDAR 表示中学习天气噪声特征，探索 CNN 在恶劣天气去噪中的作用。

name: 4DenoiseNet
title: 4DenoiseNet: Adverse Weather Denoising From Adjacent Point Clouds
summary: 联合空间邻域与相邻帧信息，用时空一致性辅助区分雪噪声和真实环境点。

name: PMDF
title: A Parametric-Adaptive Filter for Improving LiDAR Performance Under Snowfall Conditions
summary: 从历史雪噪声分布估计局部过滤参数，研究冷启动、跨数据集适应和检测收益。

name: DCOR
title: DCOR: Dynamic Channel-Wise Outlier Removal to De-Noise LiDAR Data Corrupted by Snow
summary: 在各激光通道内使用距离相关的搜索半径，减少邻域计算并适应点云采样密度。

name: TripleMixer
title: TripleMixer: A Triple-Domain Mixing Model for Point Cloud Denoising Under Adverse Weather
summary: 混合几何、频率和通道特征，结合模拟天气数据集与多种下游感知任务进行评估。

name: CRFOR
title: Snow Removal for LiDAR Point Clouds With Spatio-Temporal Conditional Random Fields
summary: 结合强度、距离和回波先验与条件随机场，对雪天点云进行结构化过滤。
